decided_by: Agent session for Alexander Kell (epic #880 PR 5 slice 1a); review in the pull request decides
rationale: AD-334: the new module archkeel.analyzer.interpreter joins the exact modules of the process component. It holds the one host function that asks one isolated python -I child for the interpreter block of a native Python request, and the encoder of that 10.0.0 request. It belongs to process because that component already owns the runtime provenance of a collector (archkeel.analyzer.runtime) and the bounded child processes. No requires entry and no budget changes: the module imports only the protocol and the codec of ir that the analyzer component already requires.
